atoms.name: Gray-code layout and adjacency
atoms.one_line: Rows and columns run 00, 01, 11, 10; neighbours differ in one bit, and edges wrap around.

atoms.name: Grouping rule
atoms.one_line: Group $2^k$ adjacent ones in a rectangle; the term keeps only the variables that stay constant.

atoms.name: Don't-care cells
atoms.one_line: Use an X as 1 only to enlarge a group; X cells never need covering.

atoms.name: Prime and essential prime implicants
atoms.one_line: A prime implicant is a group that cannot grow; an essential one covers a 1 nothing else covers.

atoms.name: Minimal sum of products
atoms.one_line: Take all essentials, then add the cheapest groups for the leftover ones; ties are possible.

atoms.name: Minimal product of sums
atoms.one_line: Group the zeros, read $\bar F$ as a sum of products, then complement it.

atoms.name: Quine-McCluskey tabular method
atoms.one_line: Group minterms by number of 1s, merge pairs that differ in one bit; terms that never merge are prime.

atoms.name: Cost of an expression
atoms.one_line: Count literals of the minimal form, or gates, such as NOR gates for a product of sums.

atoms.name: Counting prime and essential implicants
atoms.one_line: List all maximal groups, then count those with a private 1; cyclic maps have none.

atoms.name: Hazard-free covers
atoms.one_line: A static-1 hazard-free cover needs one term that contains every adjacent pair of ones.
